name: one arm lock off
description: A one-arm hold on a bar with the elbow fixed at a chosen angle, such as fully bent, 90 degrees or 120 degrees. It builds the single-arm pulling strength you need to stay in position while the other hand reaches.
instructions: Grab the bar with both hands, adding a band or pulley to take off weight if needed.
Pull up until the elbow of your working arm reaches the angle you want.
Let go with the other hand and keep the working shoulder pulled down.
Hold still for the set time without letting your body twist.
Put the free hand back on the bar and lower down under control.
